entries.question: How to opd booking
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you have the following options:

### **1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   **ORS Portal:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
    *   Select State: **Uttar Pradesh**
    *   Select Hospital: **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**
    *   Click 'New Appointment', choose your department, date, and time slot.
    *   Enter patient details and pay the **₹50 fee** online.
    *   Download your appointment slip.
*   **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA / Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

### **2. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

### **3. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   **Requirements:** You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and a mobile phone that can receive an OTP.
*   **Process:**
    1.  Visit the registration counter at the hospital.
    2.  Provide your details and Aadhaar number.
    3.  Verify the OTP received on your mobile.
    4.  Pay the **₹50 fee** at the counter to receive your physical OPD slip.

### **Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). OPD counters are closed on Sundays and Gazetted Holidays.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Wait Times:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

*I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.*

entries.answer:
KGMU mein pathology tests (jaise ki Badi Pathology) ki reports online praapt karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareeke ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **Official Website:** Aap KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar "Patient Corner" ya "Lab Reports" section check kar sakte hain. 
2. **Patient Portal:** Aksar registration ke samay diye gaye mobile number par ek link ya ID bheji jaati hai, jiske madhyam se aap apni report download kar sakte hain.
3. **Physical Collection:** Agar online portal par report update nahi dikh rahi hai, toh aapko ussi vibhag (Department of Pathology/Badi Pathology) mein jaakar apni receipt dikhani hogi, jahan se aapko hard copy mil jayegi.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
*   Main aapko medical salah nahi de sakta. Agar aapki report se sambandhit koi medical chinta hai, toh kripya KGMU ke sambandhit doctor ya OPD mein jaakar paramarsh lein.
*   **Suraksha Chetawani:** Apni personal details, jaise ki patient ID, mobile number, ya Aadhaar number is chat mein share na karein.

Yadi aapko report milne mein koi takneeki samasya aa rahi hai, toh aap PRO Office se sampark kar sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php)

KGMU ke liye filhal pathology reports **ORS (Online Registration System) portal par uplabdh nahi hoti hain**. KGMU ki reports ke liye aapko unke apane internal systems ka hi upyog karna padta hai.

Yahan kuch vikalp hain jinse aap apni report check kar sakte hain:

1.  **KGMU Official Portal:** KGMU apni lab reports ke liye apni swayam ki website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) ka upyog karta hai. Aap wahan "Patient Services" ya "Laboratory Reports" section mein jakar check kar sakte hain.
2.  **SMS/Email Notification:** Test karate samay jo mobile number aapne register karwaya tha, us par aksar report ready hone ka SMS aata hai, jismein ek link hota hai.
3.  **Departmental Collection:** Agar report online show nahi ho rahi hai, toh **Badi Pathology (Department of Pathology)** ke counter par jakar apni receipt dikhayen. Wahan se aapko physical report (hard copy) mil jayegi. 
4.  **PRO Office Help:** Agar aapko report access karne mein dikkat aa rahi hai, toh aap PRO Office (Public Relations Office) se sampark kar sakte hain. Unke contact numbers yahan diye gaye hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php)

**Dhyan dein:** 
*   KGMU, AIIMS ki tarah central government ka hospital nahi hai, isliye iska IT system AIIMS ke "e-Hospital" ya "ORS" platform se puri tarah integrated nahi hai.
*   Mein ek AI sahayak hoon, medical ya technical report ki jankari ke liye main aapko KGMU ke sahi vibhag (Pathology Department) mein jakar baat karne ki salah dunga.
*   **Suraksha Chetawani:** Kripya is chat mein apni personal details, Aadhaar number, ya patient report details share na karein.

Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya KGMU AI Assistant hoon. Agar aapko campus mein kisi department ka rasta ya koi aur jankari chahiye, toh main aapki sahayata kar sakta hoon.

entries.question: Mere patient ka ilaaj kgmu mein chal raha hai hematology mein vah blood cancer ki patient hai to doctor nahin hai bola hai ki aap aayushman card cancel karva dijiye uske bad Ham estimate banaenge tab aapka ilaaj sarkari sahayata se ho payega yah pura process Kya Hai Jara mujhe bataiyega unhone bola hai ki main pura process tab bataunga jab aap vahan se card aayushman card cancel kara kar lekar aaenge cancellation rasid
entries.answer:
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur mein samajh sakta hoon ki aapke liye ye waqt kitna mushkil hai. Blood cancer (Hematology) ka ilaaj ek lambi prakriya hoti hai. Doctor dwara di gayi salah aur sarkari sahayata (jaise CM Relief Fund ya anya yojnayein) ke liye aapko kuch mahatvapurn kadam uthane honge.

**Ayushman Card Cancellation aur Estimate ki Prakriya:**

1.  **Ayushman Card Cancellation Kyun?**
    Aksar jab koi patient kisi specific sarkari yojana (jaise Chief Minister Relief Fund ya State Illness Assistance Fund) ke antargat financial help leta hai, toh niyam hota hai ki patient ka ilaaj ya toh Ayushman Bharat se ho ya us yojana se. Dono ek saath apply nahi ho sakte. Doctor shayad isliye keh rahe hain kyunki shayad aapka ilaaj us yojana ke tehat aane wala hai jahan Ayushman card active hone par "double benefit" (duplication) ka issue aa sakta hai.

2.  **Cancellation Kaise Karwayein?**
    *   Aap apne nazdiki **Jan Seva Kendra (CSC)** ya **Ayushman Mitra** ke paas jayein jo aapke district mein ho.
    *   Wahan se aap Ayushman card cancellation ke liye request dal sakte hain.
    *   Cancellation ki official rasid (acknowledgment receipt) lena na bhoolein, kyunki doctor ne wahi manga hai.

3.  **Estimate (Anumanit Kharcha) Kaise Milega?**
    *   Jab aap cancellation ki rasid Hematology department mein jama karenge, toh wahan ke **Senior Resident ya concerned clerk** aapko ilaaj ka "Estimate Letter" (kya-kya dawa ya procedure lagega aur uska kitna kharcha aayega) bana kar denge.
    *   Is estimate par HOD (Head of Department) ke signature aur department ki seal hona anivarya hai.

4.  **Sarkari Sahayata (Financial Assistance):**
    *   Ek baar estimate mil jaane par, aapko ise **KGMU ke Medical Social Welfare Officer (MSWO)** ke office mein le jaana hoga.
    *   Wahan se aapko CM Relief Fund (CMRF) ya anya sarkari sahayata ke liye file process karni hogi.
    *   Aapko apna Aadhar card, income certificate, aur patient ke documents ki copy taiyaar rakhni hogi.

**Mere Sujhav:**

*   **PRO Office se baat karein:** KGMU mein **Patient Welfare Office** ya **PRO Office** (Trauma Centre ya Main Hospital) mein jakar is prakriya ke baare mein ek baar confirm karein. Woh aapko sahi clerk ya office ka rasta bata denge.
*   **Medical Social Welfare Officer (MSWO):** KGMU mein har bade department ke liye MSWO hote hain jo sarkari sahayata ke papers mein madad karte hain. Hematology department ke clerk se poochein ki "Hamara MSWO office kahan hai?"
*   **Savdhani:** Kisi bhi anjaan vyakti ko paise na dein. Ye sabhi sarkari prakriyaein hospital ke andar ke counters par hi hoti hain.

**Mahatvapurn:**
Main aapko medical ya legal salah nahi de sakta, lekin main aapko ye suggest karunga ki aap **Hematology Department ke HOD office** ya **Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) office** mein jakar ek baar likhit mein poochein ki "Ayushman card cancel karane ke baad aage ka kya process hai?" taaki aapka samay bache.

*Suraksha Chetawani: Kripya is chat mein patient ka naam, registration number, ya Aadhaar number share na karein.* 

Meri prarthana hai ki aapke patient ka ilaaj jald se jald shuru ho aur wo swasth ho jayein.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: My patient's treatment is going on in KGMU for hematology, and the patient is a blood cancer patient. The doctor asked to cancel the Ayushman card, and then we will make an estimate, and then the treatment will be done with government help. What is this process?

entries.question: To yah blood cancer ka ilaaj jismein admit hone ki jarurat bahut kam padati hai OPD ki davaiyon ka kharcha hota hai aur OPD ki davaiyon aur suiyon ka kharcha har mahine Kareeb 30000 se 35000 rupaye hota hai aur yah ilaaj jaisa hi doctor ne bola ki 8 Mahina se sal Bhar Tak 1 sal Tak yah ilaaj chalta Hai har mahine ₹30000 ka kharcha hota hai to is tarah kharcha Jo OPD ke through hota hai to isko aayushman khabar nahin kar sakta isliye vah bol rahe hain kya banvane ke liye aur yah kya CM relief fund se hoga ya rashtriy aarogya Nidhi se hoga yah kis Se hota Hai
entries.answer:
Aapki chinta bilkul jayaz hai. Blood cancer (jaise CML ya kuch anya prakar) ke liye jo dawaiyan (Targeted Therapy/Oral Chemotherapy) hoti hain, wo kafi mehengi hoti hain aur aksar Ayushman Bharat ki limit ya OPD criteria mein poori tarah cover nahi ho pati hain.

Is tarah ke lambe samay tak chalne wale OPD kharche ke liye sarkari sahayata ka process niche diye gaye tarikon se hota hai:

### 1. CM Relief Fund (CMRF) ya Rajya Rogi Sahayata Nidhi
Uttar Pradesh mein cancer jaise gambhir rogon ke liye **Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh (CM Relief Fund)** ya **Rajya Rogi Sahayata Nidhi** ka upyog kiya jata hai. 
*   **Kaise kaam karta hai:** Jab doctor estimate banate hain, toh wo usme 6 mahine ya 1 saal ki dawaiyon ka kul kharcha (jaise 30,000 x 12 = 3.6 Lakh) likhte hain. 
*   Is estimate ko verify karwa kar MSWO (Medical Social Welfare Officer) ke madhyam se CM office bheja jata hai. Wahan se mazoori milne par paisa hospital ke us account mein jata hai jahan dawaiyan milti hain (KGMU Pharmacy/Amrit Pharmacy).

### 2. Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
Agar patient BPL (Below Poverty Line) category mein aata hai, toh kendriya yojana **Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi** ke tahat bhi sahayata milti hai. Iske liye income certificate aur BPL card zaroori hota hai.

### 3. Doctor ne Ayushman cancel karne ko kyun kaha?
Ayushman Bharat mein "Single Window" ka niyam hota hai. Agar aapka Ayushman card active hai, toh system aapko kisi dusri sarkari yojana (jaise CM Fund) ke liye "eligible" nahi dikhata, kyunki system ko lagta hai ki aapka ilaaj pehle se hi cover ho raha hai. Isliye, doctor ne aapko cancellation ki rasid mangi hai taaki wo **"Non-availability of Ayushman coverage"** ka certificate ya file process kar sakein.

### Aapko ab kya karna chahiye? (Step-by-Step)

1.  **MSWO se Milyein:** KGMU mein Hematology department ke paas hi **Medical Social Welfare Officer (MSWO)** ka office hota hai. Aap wahan jayein aur unhe saaf batayein: *"Humein 1 saal ka dawaiyon ka estimate chahiye taaki hum CM Relief Fund mein apply kar sakein."*
2.  **Cancellation Receipt:** CSC ya Ayushman Mitra se cancellation karwane ke baad, **cancellation ki physical copy** lein aur Hematology ke clerk ko dikhayein.
3.  **Estimate Form:** Doctor se kahein ki wo "OPD-based treatment" ke liye estimate banayein. Isme dawaiyon ka naam, dosage, aur 1 saal ka kul kharcha likha hona chahiye.
4.  **Documents taiyaar rakhein:** 
    *   Patient ka Aadhar Card.
    *   Income Certificate (Tehsil se bana hua, jo 1 saal se purana na ho).
    *   BPL Card (agar ho toh).
    *   Doctor ki report aur unka recommendation letter.

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein:
*   **Amrit Pharmacy:** KGMU campus mein Amrit Pharmacy hai, jahan cancer ki mehengi dawaiyan kafi discount par milti hain. Sahayata ka paisa aksar isi pharmacy ya hospital ke pharmacy pool mein aata hai.
*   **PRO Office:** Agar MSWO se baat karne mein dikkat ho, toh **Main Hospital ke PRO Office** (Gate 2) mein jayein. Wahan "Patient Welfare" ke liye alag se desk hota hai, wo aapko sahi form bharne mein madad karenge.
*   **Dair na karein:** Blood cancer ka ilaaj beech mein nahi rukna chahiye. Agar cancellation mein waqt lag raha hai, toh doctor se request karein ki kya wo tab tak koi temporary dawa ya sample provide kar sakte hain.

**Sachet rahein:** Kisi bhi bahari agent ya dalal ko paise na dein. Ye saari sahayata sarkari prakriya hai aur iska koi charge nahi hota. 

Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya KGMU AI Assistant hoon. Aap Hematology department ke clerk se "MSWO office" ka room number zaroor pooch lein

entries.answer:
Sabse pehle, main aapki sthiti ko samajh sakta hoon. Bihar se Lucknow aakar ilaaj karwana ek bada sangharsh hai, aur main aapki puri sahayata karne ki koshish karunga.

### 1. Room Number 224 ke baare mein:
KGMU mein departments ke room number kabhi-kabhi badalte rehte hain ya alag-alag building mein hote hain. Agar Hematology ke clerk ne aapko **Room No. 224** bataya hai, toh **aap wahan zaroor jayein**. Aksar ye administrative ya files se sambandhit kamra hota hai. Wahan jakar clerk ya wahan baithe staff se poochein ki "Kya yahi Medical Social Welfare Officer (MSWO) ka office hai?"

### 2. Bihar ke mareez aur CM Relief Fund (UP):
Yahan ek mahatvapurn baat hai:
*   **CM Relief Fund (Uttar Pradesh):** Ye mukhya roop se Uttar Pradesh ke niwasiyon ke liye hota hai. 
*   **Aapke liye vikalp:** Kyunki aap Bihar ke hain, aapko **"Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi" (RAN)** ya **"Health Minister's Discretionary Grant" (HMDG)** ke liye apply karna hoga. Ye kendriya (Central Government) yojnayein hain, jo kisi bhi rajya ke mareez ko mil sakti hain agar wo KGMU jaise central/state-run institute mein ilaaj karwa rahe hain.

### 3. Aapko kya karna chahiye? (Action Plan)

1.  **MSWO Office (Sahayata Desk):** KGMU mein MSWO (Medical Social Welfare Officer) ka kaam sirf CM Fund nahi, balki har tarah ki financial help process karna hota hai. Aap wahan jakar saaf kahein: *"Main Bihar ka rehne wala hoon, mere patient ka blood cancer ka ilaaj chal raha hai, kya main Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN) ya kisi anya kendriya yojana ke liye apply kar sakta hoon?"*
2.  **Bihar Sarkar se Sahayata:** Bihar sarkar ki bhi apni "Bihar Rajya Rogi Sahayata Nidhi" hoti hai. Aap Bihar mein apne jile (Siwan) ke **Civil Surgeon office** ya **DM office** mein bhi pata kar sakte hain ki kya wo bahar ilaaj karwa rahe cancer patients ke liye koi financial aid dete hain.
3.  **Ayushman Card ka Mudda:** Agar aapka Ayushman card Bihar ka bana hua hai, toh wo shayad KGMU (UP) mein "portable" ho sakta hai. Lekin agar doctor ne ise cancel karne ko kaha hai, toh iska matlab hai ki wo aapko kisi **"Non-Ayushman"** category ki funding dilwana chahte hain. Iske baare mein aap clerk se likhit mein ya saaf-saaf poochein ki "Cancel karane ke baad mujhe kaunsi yojana ka labh milega?"

### 4. Mera Sujhav:
*   **Ghabrayein nahi:** Hospital mein clerk ya staff kabhi-kabhi jaldi mein hote hain. Aap unse vinamrata se kahein ki aap Bihar se aaye hain aur aapke liye har ek din bahut keemti hai.
*   **PRO Office (Main Hospital Gate 2):** Agar Room 224 mein kaam na bane, toh seedhe **PRO Office** jayein. Wahan ke officer ko batayein ki aap Bihar se hain aur financial help ke liye guidance chahiye. Wo aapko sahi jagah bhej denge.
*   **Documents:** Apne saath Bihar ka **Residential Proof (Awas Praman Patra)**, **Income Certificate**, aur patient ke saare medical papers hamesha ek file mein rakhein.

**Ek zaroori baat:** Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya KGMU AI Assistant hoon. Main aapke documents nahi dekh sakta, isliye kripya kisi bhi office mein jaane se pehle apne files check kar lein. 

**Suraksha Chetawani:** Kisi bhi bahari vyakti (dalal) se door rahein jo kahe ki "main aapka card cancel karwa dunga ya paise dilwa dunga." Saara kaam hospital ke official counters par hi karein.

Kya aapko Room 224 dhundhne mein koi dikkat ho rahi hai? Main aapko campus ka rasta batane mein madad kar sakta hoon.

Lekin, aapko pareshan hone ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aap in official rasto se jankari le sakte hain:

### 1. PRO Office ko Call Karein (Sabse behtar rasta)
PRO (Public Relations Office) ka kaam hi yahi hai ki wo aapko sahi department ya officer se connect karein. Aap unhe call karke kahein: *"Main Bihar se hoon, mere patient ka Hematology mein ilaaj chal raha hai, mujhe Financial Assistance/MSWO se baat karni hai, kya aap mujhe unka extension ya sahi number de sakte hain?"*

*   **PRO Office, GM&AH KGMU:** 0522-2258880 (Extn. 3) ya Direct: **9415007710**
*   **Help Line Number:** 0522-2258880

### 2. Hematology Department ka contact:
Aap Hematology department ke clerk ya office se direct baat karne ki koshish karein. Aap website se unka official email bhi try kar sakte hain:
*   **Hematology Department:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=10&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=10&dept_type=2)

### 3. Bihar ke mareezon ke liye sujhav:
Jab aap call karein, toh ye sawal zaroor poochein:
*   "Kya main **Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)** ke liye apply kar sakta hoon?"
*   "Kya mujhe **Ayushman Card cancel** karne ka certificate Lucknow mein hi dena hoga ya Bihar se karwa kar bhejna hoga?"
*   "Kya main sahayata ke liye documents **post ya email** ke zariye bhej sakta hoon?"

### 4. Mera Sujhav (Aapke liye):
Chunki aap Bihar mein hain, phone par aksar clerk ya officer puri baat nahi samjha paate. Aap apne kisi janne wale ko jo Lucknow mein ho, unhe **Hematology Department ke clerk ke paas** bhejiye. Wo wahan jakar "Patient ID" ke sath inquiry kar sakte hain aur MSWO ka sahi kamra number ya contact number wahan se note kar sakte hain.

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   Call karte samay patient ka **KGMU Registration Number** apne paas rakhein.
*   Agar koi phone na uthaye, toh **PRO Office (9415007710)** par call karna sabse zyada asardaar hota hai.

Main Dr. Ayush Yadav dwara banaya gaya KGMU AI Assistant hoon. Main aapke liye prarthana karta hoon ki aapke patient ko jald sahayata mile. Kripya dhyan rakhein ki kisi bhi anjaan number par paisa na bhejein, sahayata ki prakriya hamesha official hospital channels se hi hoti hai.

entries.question: में अपनी माता जी का मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र डाउनलोड कैसे करे
entries.answer:
मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र (Death Certificate) से संबंधित जानकारी के लिए कृपया नीचे दिए गए चरणों का पालन करें:

1. **आधिकारिक वेबसाइट:** सबसे पहले आपको उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट **[edistrict.up.gov.in](https://edistrict.up.gov.in/)** पर जाना होगा।
2. **नगर निगम/नगर पालिका:** यदि मृत्यु लखनऊ में हुई थी, तो आप **[lmc.up.nic.in](http://lmc.up.nic.in/)** (लखनऊ नगर निगम) की वेबसाइट पर जाकर 'Death Certificate' के विकल्प को देख सकते हैं।
3. **प्रक्रिया:** 
   - यदि प्रमाण पत्र पहले से बना हुआ है, तो आप वेबसाइट पर 'Download Certificate' विकल्प का उपयोग करके आवेदन संख्या या पंजीकरण संख्या दर्ज करके इसे डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।
   - यदि अभी तक प्रमाण पत्र नहीं बना है, तो आपको संबंधित अस्पताल (जहाँ मृत्यु हुई) से जारी 'Death Report' के साथ नगर निगम के कार्यालय या ई-डिस्ट्रिक्ट पोर्टल पर आवेदन करना होगा।

**महत्वपूर्ण सूचना:**
- KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट (www.kgmu.org) पर मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र सीधे डाउनलोड करने की सुविधा नहीं है। यह प्रक्रिया स्थानीय नगर निगम (Municipal Corporation) या संबंधित सरकारी पोर्टल के माध्यम से ही पूरी की जाती है।
- अधिक सहायता के लिए आप KGMU के **PRO ऑफिस** (संपर्क: 0522-2258880) से संपर्क कर सकते हैं, वे आपको यह मार्गदर्शन दे सकते हैं कि अस्पताल से संबंधित रिकॉर्ड कैसे प्राप्त करें।

मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ जिसे डॉ. आयुष यादव द्वारा बनाया गया है। यदि आपको स्वास्थ्य संबंधी कोई समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU OPD में डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए कृपया इस चैट में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी जैसे आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर साझा न करें।

* **ओपीडी का समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को ओपीडी बंद रहती है।

* **सलाह:** भीड़ से बचने के लिए प्री-बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है।

entries.question: Opd me kaise patient ko dekhae
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD ke liye patient ko dikhane ki prakriya niche di gayi hai:

**1. Appointment Kaise Book Karein (Anivarya/Mandatory):**
KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration karwana anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon se appointment le sakte hain:
*   **Online Portal:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par login karke KGMU select karein aur appointment book karein.
*   **Mobile App:** 'ABHA' ya 'Health Care' app ka upyog karein.
*   **SMS dwara:** "Appointment [Patient Name]" likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.
*   **On-Site (Walk-in):** Agar aap hospital aate hain, toh apna **Aadhaar Card** aur **Active Mobile Number** sath layein. Counter par OTP verify hone ke baad aapko token milega.

**2. OPD Fee:**
Sabhi booking methods ke liye **₹50** ka shulk (fee) lagta hai.

**3. Zaruri Jankari:**
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne sambandhit department ka valid referral letter sath zaroor layein.
*   **Samay:** OPD Parchi (Ticket) counter dopahar **1:00 PM** baje band ho jata hai, isliye subah jaldi aana behtar hai.
*   **Sahayata:** Kisi bhi pareshani ke liye aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call kar sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
Main ek AI sahayak hoon aur chikitsya (medical) salah nahi de sakta. Kripya apni bimari ya lakshano ke baare mein yahan vistar se na batayein. Apni suraksha ke liye personal health details, Aadhaar number ya phone number yahan share na karein. Sahi ilaj aur paramarsh ke liye KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein.

entries.question: neet ug obc ke liya marks kitne hone chaiye
entries.answer:
NEET UG mein OBC category ke liye qualify karne ke liye minimum percentile aur marks har saal paper ke level ke hisaab se badalte rehte hain.

1. **Qualifying Percentile:** OBC candidates ke liye NEET UG qualify karne ka minimum criteria **40th percentile** hota hai.
2. **Marks (Cut-off):** Ye marks har saal "All India Rank" aur paper ki kathinai (difficulty level) par depend karte hain. Pichle kuch saalon ka trend dekhein to, OBC category ke liye qualify karne ke liye aamtaur par **160-170+ marks** (720 mein se) ki avashyakta hoti hai, lekin ye sirf **qualifying** marks hain.
3. **Admission (College Seat):** KGMU jaise top government medical college mein admission lene ke liye sirf "qualify" hona kaafi nahi hai. KGMU mein seat paane ke liye aapko **bahut high rank aur marks** (aamtaur par 650-670+ marks) ki zaroorat hoti hai, kyunki competition bahut zyada hota hai.

**Important Points:**
*   **Official Data:** Har saal ka exact cut-off NTA (National Testing Agency) dwara result ke time par release kiya jaata hai.
*   **KGMU Admission:** KGMU mein admission NEET UG ki counselling (MCC - Medical Counselling Committee) ke through hota hai.

Main aapko salah doonga ki aap apni taiyaari par focus karein aur target hamesha **650+ marks** ka rakhein taaki aapko safe side par seat mil sake. Aap NTA ki official website [exams.nta.ac.in/NEET](https://exams.nta.ac.in/NEET/) par jakar pichle saalon ka official cut-off data check kar sakte hain.
